name: glyphtest_build
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess, os
os.makedirs("qa/tmp", exist_ok=True)
r1 = subprocess.run(["groff","-Tps","-ms","qa/glyphtest.roff"],capture_output=True)
print("groff rc", r1.returncode, "stderr", r1.stderr.decode()[:2000])
open("qa/tmp/glyph.ps","wb").write(r1.stdout)
r2 = subprocess.run(["ps2pdf","qa/tmp/glyph.ps","qa/tmp/glyph.pdf"],capture_output=True)
print("ps2pdf rc", r2.returncode, r2.stderr.decode()[:2000])
r3 = subprocess.run(["pdftotext","qa/tmp/glyph.pdf","-"],capture_output=True)
print("pdftotext rc", r3.returncode)
print(repr(r3.stdout.decode()))
